business_problem: As the first airport to serve more than 100 million passengers in a single year, Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL) is the busiest in the world. To manage the fluctuations of high-volume passengers with a positive customer experience while also driving non-aeronautical revenue growth, a consolidated platform with real-time insights across various data types is required.
solution_summary: Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport built its Databricks implementation around Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks Data + AI Platform, Databricks Assistant. As the first airport to serve more than 100 million passengers in a single year, Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL) is the busiest in the world. To manage the fluctuations of high-volume passengers with a positive customer experience while also driving non-aeronautical revenue growth, a consolidated platform with real-time insights across various data types is required. Delta Lake stores curated lakehouse tables with ACID guarantees for downstream analytics and machine learning. Unity Catalog applies centralized governance, lineage, auditing, and access control across shared data assets. Databricks Data + AI Platform provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workflows in this deployment.

solution_components.name: Databricks Assistant
solution_components.role: Helps practitioners accelerate code, query, and troubleshooting work inside the Databricks workspace.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Presents dashboards and reports to business users and planners.

data_flow: Source data is ingested into databricks, curated in Delta Lake tables, processed with Databricks compute and orchestration services, and exposed to downstream analytics and users. It connects with Power BI.
business_outcome: Since unifying its data on the Databricks Data + AI Platform, ATL is discovering new airport trends through fast and trustworthy data insights that improve airport operations and revenue at scale. Now, the organization is flying faster with fewer resources, a single source of truth and new opportunities for AI use cases not previously available.
metrics: Faster time to insights, from 30 to 5 minutes, to improve airport operations
